question: What result follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Abstention from eating by day is stated
Death related to age is named
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death due to age.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may idiomatically mean overcome or pass beyond death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death from old age.
